endorsements.name: Runzi Zhao
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-27592
endorsements.description:
An unquoted search path or element vulnerability has been reported to affect QVR Smart Client. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow local authenticated administrators to execute unauthorized code or commands via unspecified vectors.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Windows 10 SP1, Windows 11, Mac OS, and Mac M1: QVR Smart Client 2.4.0.0570 and later
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.7)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Runzi Zhao
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-27595
endorsements.description:
An insecure library loading vulnerability has been reported to affect QVPN Device Client. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow local attackers who have gained user access to execute unauthorized code or commands.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following versions:
QVPN Windows 2.0.0.1316 and later
QVPN Windows 2.0.0.1310 and later
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.8)

endorsements.label: CVE-2022-27599
endorsements.description:
An insertion of sensitive information into Log file vulnerability has been reported to affect product. If exploited, the vulnerability possibly provides local authenticated administrators with an additional, less-protected path to acquiring the information via unspecified vectors.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Windows 10 SP1, Windows 11, Mac OS, and Mac M1: QVR Pro Client 2.3.0.0420 and later

endorsements.label: CVE-2023-23370
endorsements.description:
An insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability has been reported to affect QVPN Device Client. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow local authenticated administrators to gain access to user accounts and access sensitive data used by the user account via unspecified vectors.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
QVPN Windows 2.1.0.0518 and later
